title: Conformal IFF & CNI Antenna Apertures
summary: Flush conformal Communications, Navigation, and Identification (CNI) and IFF antenna apertures integrated into the airframe skin.
role: Enables encrypted intra-flight data link, Link 16 receive, voice communications, and IFF without protruding blade drag/RCS.
materials: Flush radar-transparent dielectric windows over phased-array elements.
